verse_renderings.text: I know that my distress will become my deliverance through your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ.
My eager hope and expectation is that I will not be ashamed in any way. Instead, I hope to have complete courage so that now, as always, Christ will be honored in my body, whether I live or die.
For to me, living means living for Christ, and dying means gaining something even better.
But if living on in this body means more fruitful work for me, then I honestly don’t know which one to choose!
I am torn between the two. I long to leave this life and be with Christ—that would be far better.
But for your sake, it is more necessary that I remain in this body.
Since I am convinced of this, I know I will stay. I will remain with all of you so that you can grow and experience joy in your faith.
Then, when I return to you, you will have even more reason to be proud of what Christ Jesus has done in me.
